title: Messy CSV cleanup
objective: Exercise the data-cleaning class with messy CSV fixtures, dedupe rules, date normalization, and deterministic JSON output.
prompt: Can you biuld us a little page for this? The content notes are in source/page-content.md. Save it as index.html — one file, nothing fancy needed on our end.

files.content:
# Clean a Dataset Eval Brief

Client: Boreal Desk, a home-office accessories company.
Audience: operations leads who need an artifact they can use this week.

Fixed source facts for grounding:
- The returns desk pilot covered 18 SKUs.
- Median first response improved from 18 hours to 6 hours.
- Preventable refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%.
- The top unresolved complaint is status silence after photo submission.
- Required next actions are automated status emails, barcode-exception training, and a weekly Finance exception export.

Use these facts when the task asks for prose, analysis, copy, UI content, or test data. Do not use live web services, real credentials, or current outside data.

Craftbook under test: dataset-clean - Clean a Dataset.

# Boreal Desk Support Board

Build content around a support operations board. Required labels: Open issues, Status silence, Response time, Refund leakage, Next action. Required metric text: 18 hours to 6 hours and 14.2% to 8.9%.

success.summary: The hand-authored data-wrangle grader validates parseability, schema, normalization, dedupe, row count, ordering, and golden records.
